title: I Played a Tournament as the Lowest Rated Player...
summary: Tony (~1900) reviews his games from an OTB tournament where he played up in the top section under the 100-point rule: round-1 bye, a loss to a 2300 (black), draws vs ~2132 and ~2070, then a round-5 game vs a 2073 that he loses to a silly mistake. Ends with three lessons: study openings, give up a pawn rather than compromise the position, calculate.
